blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, ZAMBOANGA DEL SUR, Philippines — The United States flexed its muscles in the country’s fight against terrorism, boosting the capability of the Philippine National Police with a specialized counterterrorism and bomb-disposal training for 40 elite Filipino officers at a newly launched regional security hub in Mindanao located in this city. The graduates—24 personnel from the Special Action Force and 16 Explosive and Ordnance Disposal experts—finished the Crisis and Response Training and Explosive and Ordnance Disposal courses during a joint closing ceremony on Monday at the Provincial Government Center in Barangay Dao here.
